summary: Waldencast plc filed a Form 25 with the SEC on September 24, 2026 to voluntarily delist its Class A Ordinary Shares and redeemable warrants from Nasdaq and deregister them under Section 12(b) of the Exchange Act. Last trading day on Nasdaq is expected on or about October 2, 2026, with delisting effective on or about October 4, 2026; Section 12(b) deregistration becomes effective 90 days after filing. The company intends to file a Form 15 on or about October 5, 2026, immediately suspending periodic reporting obligations. No board recommendation, advisor, price, or consideration is stated. Watch for liquidity loss, warrant exercise dynamics, and any withdrawal or postponement of filings.
